caribbean.headline: Heavy Rain and Choppy Seas in Western Caribbean
caribbean.paragraph: Roatan in the western Caribbean is experiencing sustained winds to 23 kt, seas to 5.6 ft with an ENE dominant swell and an 8 s period, and 100% rain probability. I recommend small-boat operators secure vessels and avoid exposed passages until the heaviest rain eases; Dominica will see winds near 18 kt with periods of heavy showers and reduced visibility.

mediterranean.headline: Mykonos Winds Reach 25 kt, Seas to 6.5 ft
mediterranean.paragraph: Mykonos is experiencing a WNW swell with sustained winds near 25 kt, seas to 6.5 ft and a 7 s swell period, and carrying less than 10% rain probability. I advise small-craft interests to exercise caution around Mykonos as winds meet Small Craft Advisory thresholds, while Naples remains light with about 8 kt winds and much calmer seas.
